recommendations.issue: Perceived poor value for money / High pricing.
recommendations.action: Conduct a comprehensive menu engineering analysis, comparing current pricing, portion sizes, ingredient costs, and competitor pricing. Consider introducing value-focused specials or adjusting prices/portions for key items to better align with customer expectations.
recommendations.expected_impact: Increased customer satisfaction with value, potentially higher sales volume, and an improved perception of fairness and affordability.

recommendations.action: Implement a standardized recipe and preparation guide for all menu items. Conduct mandatory kitchen staff retraining on these standards and increase quality control checks during service, focusing on consistency and ingredient freshness.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved consistency and overall quality of dishes, leading to higher customer satisfaction, positive reviews, and increased repeat visits.

recommendations.issue: General negative customer experience / Lack of attention to detail.
recommendations.action: Implement a daily pre-opening checklist for all staff covering cleanliness, table setup, music, lighting, and general readiness. Encourage staff to proactively identify and address minor operational issues or customer discomfort throughout service.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more polished and consistent dining environment, reducing minor annoyances and significantly improving overall customer perception and satisfaction.

recommendations.action: Conduct mandatory customer service training workshops focusing on positive communication, active listening, problem-solving, and empathy. Implement a system for regular staff feedback and recognition to boost morale and reinforce desired behaviors.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved staff-customer interactions, leading to a more welcoming and helpful atmosphere, higher customer satisfaction, and reduced negative service-related feedback.

recommendations.action: Conduct an internal audit of the dining area's decor, lighting, seating comfort, and noise levels. Prioritize small, cost-effective improvements like updated lighting, fresh paint, sound dampening panels, or comfortable seating arrangements.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more pleasant and comfortable dining environment, enhancing the overall customer experience, encouraging longer stays, and improving the restaurant's aesthetic appeal.
